import argparse, ast, contextlib, io, pathlib, shlex, subprocess, sys, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
q = chr(34)
src = pathlib.Path('scripts/reconstruct_run.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
tree = ast.parse(src)
def is_group_call(n):
    return isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr == 'add_mutually_exclusive_group'
groups = set()
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and is_group_call(node.value):
        groups.update(t.id for t in node.targets if isinstance(t, ast.Name))
bad, star = [], False
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and node.func.attr == 'add_argument':
        names = [a.value for a in node.args if isinstance(a, ast.Constant) and isinstance(a.value, str)]
        nargs = [k.value.value for k in node.keywords if k.arg == 'nargs' and isinstance(k.value, ast.Constant)]
        recv = node.func.value
        in_group = (isinstance(recv, ast.Name) and recv.id in groups) or is_group_call(recv)
        if in_group and (nargs == ['*'] or any(not n.startswith('-') for n in names)):
            bad.append(names)
        if names == ['run_ids'] and nargs == ['*']:
            star = True
assert not bad, ('positional or nargs=* argument inside a mutually exclusive group', bad)
assert star, 'run_ids must stay a nargs=* positional'
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
orig = argparse._MutuallyExclusiveGroup._add_action
def strict(self, action):
    if action.required or not action.option_strings:
        raise ValueError('mutually exclusive arguments must be optional')
    return orig(self, action)
argparse._MutuallyExclusiveGroup._add_action = strict
import reconstruct_run
buf = io.StringIO()
try:
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        reconstruct_run.main(['--help'])
except SystemExit as exc:
    assert exc.code == 0, exc.code
else:
    raise AssertionError('--help did not exit')
argparse._MutuallyExclusiveGroup._add_action = orig
assert 'run_ids' in buf.getvalue() and '--all' in buf.getvalue(), buf.getvalue()
script = str(root / 'scripts' / 'reconstruct_run.py')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    both = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', script, 'm', 'r1', '--all'], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
    none = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', script, 'm'], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert both.returncode == 2 and both.stderr.strip() == 'ERROR: reconstruct: run ids and --all cannot be combined' and both.stdout == '', both
assert none.returncode == 2 and 'Traceback' not in none.stderr, none
wf = pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
suite = wf.index('run: bash tests/run-tests.sh')
for needle in ('apt-get install -y tmux jq', 'brew install tmux jq', 'pip install jsonschema', 'import jsonschema'):
    assert needle in wf and wf.index(needle) < suite, needle
for f in ('tests/test-fleet-state.py', 'tests/test-fleet-v2.py'):
    code = 'import runpy, sys; sys.modules[' + repr('jsonschema') + '] = None; sys.argv = [' + repr(f) + ']; runpy.run_path(' + repr(f) + ', run_name=' + repr('__main__') + ')'
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    out = p.stdout + p.stderr
    assert p.returncode != 0 and 'jsonschema required for this test' in out and 'Traceback' not in out, (f, p.returncode, out[-800:])
    assert 'SKIP schema/code agreement' not in pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), f
rt = pathlib.Path('tests/run-tests.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
line = next(l for l in rt if l.startswith('check ' + q + 'harness PATH helper prepends existing tool directories once under set -u' + q))
argv = shlex.split(line)
assert argv[2:4] == ['bash', '-c'] and len(argv) == 5, argv
body = argv[4]
assert 'unset PATH' in body and 'command -v python3' in body and body.index('command -v python3') < body.index('unset PATH'), body
tail = body[body.index('unset PATH'):]
assert ' python3 -c' not in tail and ';python3 -c' not in tail, tail
run = subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', body], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert run.returncode == 0, run.stdout + run.stderr
print('ok')
